flows:
Navigate to https://www.colorhexa.com/0066ff then Use Tab, Shift+Tab, arrow keys, Page Up, Page Down, Home, End, text entry, Space and Enter only.
Stay on this public site.
Do not sign in, register, pay, or interact with a CAPTCHA or access challenge.
Leave fixture settings unchanged.
Use visible controls only.
Open the color picker using the swatch next to the color search field.
Stop when the color spectrum panel and hue slider are visible.

summary:
The visible color swatch is not keyboard focusable, so a keyboard-only user has no way to open the color picker and reveal the spectrum and hue slider.
Make the swatch a real button, or give it keyboard focus and support Enter and Space to open the picker.
